contract_clauses: YAML is cold authoring only; runtime never interprets YAML, parses JSON, serves HTTP, or routes text commands.
Strict YAML authoring must compile through validation and lowering into numeric IR.
Accepted artifact is the unit of trust for admission, persistence, replay, and recovery.
Fjall persistence and Postcard records are required for workflow source, compiled IR, run headers, journal events, snapshots, blobs, and indexes.
Bounded deterministic runtime execution must enforce queues, frame pools, retries, fanout, trace rings, expression stacks, and IPC frame limits.
Recovery and replay must be typed, durable, fail-closed, and must not reparse YAML.
UI and generated Rust/codegen parity are excluded from this engine-only acceptance root.
required_verifier_modes: Kani/Verus/TLA/Loom/property evidence where dependency scope demands it
coverage and mutation smoke where engine-scope acceptance demands it
